quarterly_data.quarter: Supermicro press release: Supermicro Introduces the NVIDIA Vera CPU Rack, a 256 CPU, (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supermicro introduced the NVIDIA Vera CPU rack, a 100% liquid-cooled rack-scale system with 256 NVIDIA Vera CPUs and BlueField-4 DPUs for agent sandboxes, complementing NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 on common DCBBS infrastructure (third-generation NVIDIA MGX racks, battery backup units) and integrating the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform and OpenShell reference architecture; it is available to quote now (an air-cooled option is mentioned by CEO Charles Liang).
